question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

His strict adherence to the schedule was remarkable, displaying an extraordinary level of__ rigidity.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flexibility**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"rigidity"** refers to the quality of being stiff, inflexible, or unable to adapt or change. (कठोरता)

 
 
• **Example: **His rigidity in following outdated rules made it difficult for the team to innovate.
 
 
 
• **"Flexibility"** is the ability to adapt, change, or adjust easily to new circumstances or conditions. It is the opposite of rigidity. (लचीलापन)
 
 
• **Example: **The flexibility of the new schedule allowed employees to balance work and personal life more effectively.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'rigidity'** is **'flexibility'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Flexibility**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Complexity** (जटिलता): The state or quality of being intricate or complicated.

 
 
• **Example:** The complexity of the problem required a team of experts to solve it.
 
 
 
• **Uniformity** (एकरूपता): The quality or state of being the same in all cases and at all times.
 
 
• **Example:** The uniforms ensured uniformity among the students during the parade.
 
 
 
• **Consistency** (संगति): The quality of always behaving or performing in a similar way, or of always happening in a similar way.
 
 
• **Example:** Her consistency in delivering high-quality work earned her a promotion.
